shared_elements: monolithic standing anthropomorphic figure carved in the round
frontal human face with prominent brow ridge, nose and eyes at the top of a columnar block
broad shoulders/upper body below the head, tapering block-like body
headdress or cap-like element over the head
schematic, blocky rendering of the human form
justification: Both depict the same distinctive scheme: a columnar monolithic anthropomorph with a large frontal face crowned by a cap or headdress-like band at the top of the block, broad squared shoulders beneath, and an undifferentiated tapering body with no legs indicated. The chief difference is that A carries elaborate low-relief surface iconography on the body (bands, discs/circles, curvilinear and interlocking motifs, a pendant-like disc on the chest), whereas B is a plain, unornamented figure whose only depicted content is the face and its heavy modelled features.
